sections.heading: Arm Lipo 360° & Arm Lift
paragraphs: Arm Lipo 360° and Arm Lift surgery are body contouring procedures designed to create slimmer, smoother, more toned-looking arms. These procedures target stubborn fat, loose skin, and excess tissue to improve overall arm definition while maintaining soft, feminine contours.

Arm Lipo 360° uses advanced liposuction techniques to contour the entire upper arm from multiple angles for balanced, natural-looking results. An Arm Lift, also known as Brachioplasty, removes excess skin and tightens the upper arms, commonly after weight loss or significant skin laxity.

At Tampa Bay Body Sculpting, we work with a carefully selected network of Board-Certified Cosmetic Surgeons in Florida experienced in advanced arm contouring procedures for women. Every treatment plan is personalized based on your anatomy, skin elasticity, and desired aesthetic goals.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
paragraphs: Please reach us at info@tampabaybodysculpting.com if you cannot find an answer to your question.

Arm liposuction is a cosmetic procedure that removes stubborn fat from the upper arms to create a slimmer, more defined appearance. It is ideal for patients who have localized fat deposits that have not responded to diet and exercise and want improved arm contour.
Women with stubborn upper arm fat, loose skin, or loss of arm definition may be good candidates. Ideal candidates are in good overall health and looking to achieve slimmer, more toned-looking arms.

Arm liposuction commonly treats: Upper Arms, Outer Arms, Inner Arms, Posterior Arms (back of the arm), and Axillary Fat (underarm area, when appropriate). Treatment is customized based on your anatomy and aesthetic goals.

Arm Lipo 360° focuses on removing stubborn fat and contouring the arms using liposuction techniques, while an Arm Lift removes excess skin and tightens the upper arm area. In some cases, both procedures may be combined for optimal results.
Arm liposuction can: remove stubborn upper arm fat, create slimmer, more sculpted arms, improve arm definition, enhance overall body proportions, improve clothing fit, and increase confidence.

Most patients experience swelling, bruising, and soreness during the first 1–2 weeks of recovery after surgery. Compression garments are commonly worn to support healing and optimize contouring results.
We offer financing options to help make arm liposuction more affordable. During your consultation, we'll review available payment plans and financing options to fit your budget.

Ready to achieve slimmer, more sculpted arms? Schedule your consultation with Tampa Bay Body Sculpting today. We'll discuss your goals, answer your questions, and create a personalized treatment plan designed specifically for you.
Yes. Arm liposuction is often combined with Lipo 360, tummy tuck, thigh liposuction, breast surgery, or other body contouring procedures to achieve more comprehensive results.

Arm liposuction removes excess fat but does not remove significant loose skin. Patients with good skin elasticity often experience natural skin tightening during healing. If significant skin laxity is present, your provider may recommend an arm lift (brachioplasty) instead of or in addition to liposuction.
Arm liposuction uses very small incisions that are strategically placed in discreet locations whenever possible. Over time, these small scars typically fade and become less noticeable.

Arm liposuction can improve the appearance of excess fat in the upper arms, often referred to as "bat wings." If the concern is primarily excess fat and the skin has good elasticity, liposuction may provide excellent contouring. If significant loose skin is present, an arm lift (brachioplasty) may be recommended to remove excess skin and achieve the best results.
